title: 2021-22 Donruss #51 Ricky Rubio Cleveland Cavaliers Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021-22 Donruss Basketball trading card featuring NBA player Ricky Rubio from the Cleveland Cavaliers. This single card is an original from the Donruss brand, part of the modern era of sports trading cards. It is a collectible item for basketball fans and collectors, showcasing the player in his Cleveland Cavaliers uniform for the 2021-22 season. The card is in near mint/mint condition and is a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection.
